svg.title: Strands and Gemini execution against pallets/flask
svg.desc: Terminal output for the Strands and Gemini pallets/flask risk analysis.

text.tspan: * **Most Important Delivery Risk:** **None (Zero active high/medium delivery risks).** The project is currently assessed as **On Track**. The only tracked item is a minor documentation request ([#6146](https://github.com/pallets/flask/issues/6146)).
* **Evidence:** 0 of 1 tracked issue bears active risk. Issue #6146 is an unblocked enhancement proposal regarding documentation ("Add Cloudflare to Flask Hosting Platforms docs?").
* **Downstream Impact:** Zero downstream issues or dependent tasks are exposed to risk. Core framework releases and operational posture are completely unaffected.

* **Consequence of Inaction:** Negligible operational impact. Leaving the issue unaddressed simply means Cloudflare will not yet be listed in the hosting platform documentation. Core platform delivery and user workflows remain unaffected.

* **Single Best Next Decision for Manager:** **Maintain current operational posture and review Issue #6146 during standard triage/documentation sprint planning.** No emergency intervention or re-allocation of engineering resources is required.
🔴 0 High Risk    🟡 0 Medium Risk    🟢 1 On Track
